owner_request: 2026-11-05 "针对我们信号中心的信号（12h的，4h,1h,15min）再做模型做评分？"; 2026-11-06 plan approved "按方案开训" (same rule per timeframe, entry at confirmation close, offline training under the P0/P1 gate).
question: Can a LightGBM score rank signal-center cloud signals (EMA20/50 + NY Monday 1.618 wick reclaim) on 12H/4H/1H/15m so that the top group is net-positive after real fees, above matched random controls, out of time?
single_variable: New study. Signal rule, stops and exits are the signal-center definitions applied unchanged on each timeframe; the only new element is the score. LightGBM parameters reused from exp-clean-reversal-score-20261101-v1 without search.
source_note: Frozen 633-asset Monday-limit cohort; 632 Binance UM crypto jobs (626 native 5m, 6 native 1m aggregated to complete 5m), 2020-01-01..2026-09-23. XAUUSD excluded. No downloads. All symbols still trade in 2026-09 (survivorship).
signal_rule: yoyo/monitor/cloud_signals.signal on UTC-aligned complete bars of each timeframe; first per symbol x NY week x timeframe; Monday range from 288 complete 5m bars.
entry: Market at the signal bar close (taker).
stop: Touched 1.618 * (1 - side*pct); pct 1.5% BTC/ETH, 3% others (cloud_signal_plans.fixed_stop); tick-rounded outward.
exit: First of the fixed stop and the intrabar EMA20/50 cross of the signal timeframe (cross price from the prior closed bar's EMA state, re-armed at each timeframe close; level through the close exits at that close). No target. Missing timeframe bar forces exit; data end marks censored.
engine: NautilusTrader 1.231.0 via yoyo.layers.l3_backtest.nautilus_stop_schedule.run_schedule on 5m bars, run once.
fee_note: OKX Lv1 read 2026-10-23; every fill here is market/stop = taker. Slippage reported separately as 5bp per market fill (10bp per trade).
controls: Up to 3 matched random entries per signal: same symbol, timeframe, NY week window, side; EMA aligned with side; not a raw signal bar; same floor(4*log2(ATR14/close)) bucket; same close-to-stop distance and exit rule; crc32-seeded, never chosen by outcome.
label: net_bp > 0 (binary) for training; net_bp for evaluation.
evaluation: Per timeframe and fold: all signals, top 10% / top 20% / bottom 20% by score within the test fold; week-stratified score permutation (2000) for the top-group mean; random same-size signal subsets; paired signal-minus-matched-control difference with week-cluster bootstrap CI; three single-feature baselines (pen_atr, rr_close, ema_spread_atr) with direction from training correlation; AUC reference only.
success: Both test years: top 20% mean net_bp > 0, week-stratified permutation p < 0.01, and top-20% signals beat their matched controls (paired CI above 0).
limitations: Binance UM bars vs live OKX; survivorship cohort; cross-sectional clustering on market-wide days; 4H/1H/15m signals are not live in the signal center; the live reference entry (touched 1.618) is not executable and is replaced by the confirmation close.
